exposure: history of prior admission in hospitals during the neonatal period
cohort: 100 children aged 2-15 years with type 1 diabetes and 100 age and sex-matched healthy children.
finding: Children exposed to maternal gestational diabetes and preeclampsia had an increased risk of developing type 1 diabetes, and birth weight above 4 kg was also associated with increased risk.
birth_weight: Recorded but specific ranges not provided, except for birth weight above 4 kg
